obligations.text: A `ModelRanking` and a `Selection` are distinct value kinds with no conversion to or from scores, distributions, calibrated probabilities, labels or ordinal levels; no probability threshold, label condition, expectation or `weighted_rank@1` component reads them, and a ranking score is compared only with scores of the same ranking request.

Every position of a selection carries its origin (`model` or `backfill`), its source position and its derivation class; a backfill position comes only from a declared ordering whose static class is exact-derived, never repeats a selected id, and never introduces an id outside the ranked candidate pool.

A model ranking whose backend failed is never treated as an empty or partial ranking: `select` either fills every position from its backfill with a `fallback` notice (`backfill_all`) or is unresolved with the failure's reason (`propagate`), and evidence reasons (missing, stale, conflicting, invalid) always propagate.
A pairwise ranking issues its comparisons in the schedule's deterministic order, never more than `max_comparisons`, and the same answers yield the same order, win counts and cycle count on every run.

Position-bias controls are off unless declared; when declared, their kind, order count and seed enter the plan identity, and every presented order is a pure function of the seed, the step, the instance and the request index through `rustev.permute/1`.
A definition that uses no construct of this spec, and a descriptor without a `ranking` member, keep byte-identical documents, `DescriptorId`s and `PlanId`s, proven by the existing goldens.
Listwise answers drop unknown ids, ids outside the pool and duplicates with recorded reasons; a list shorter than the pool is a partial ranking, not an error.

The rules backend answers pointwise `rank` tasks deterministically, so the same plan can be run with the rules backend and with a model backend with no change to the policy, the outcomes or any authority path.

sectionHeadings: 039: Model-backed rank and deterministic backfill (amends 002 and 005)
record.summary: An amendment of approved specs 002 and 005 (R-16), for #76 child C2. Adds a `rank` step kind with three declared modes (listwise, pointwise, pairwise) over a bounded candidate pool, a distinct `ModelRanking` value kind that records partial rankings, dropped ids with reasons, scores scoped to one ranking request and pairwise win counts, optional identity-bearing position-bias controls driven by a named seeded generator, and a `select` step that fills k positions from a model ranking and, when it is short or its backend failed, from a declared exact ordering, with per-position origin and derivation. Pairwise schedules are deterministic and bounded by `max_comparisons`; cycles are resolved by win count, then an exact tie-break, and counted. The constructs join the #76 track versions (`rustev.definition/2`, `rustev.plan/3`, `rustev.evidence/2`); the backend descriptor gains an optional `ranking` member. The rules backend (spec 005) answers pointwise `rank` for the swap test. Bedrock (spec 030) admits its reserved `rank` value under 030 3.12. Jev (specs 012 and 022) keeps R-28: rankings over Jev answers stay composed in plans and feed `select` unchanged. Plans that use none of this keep byte-identical identities. Approved (A-36); implementation is pending.
